title: Underfloor heating in an existing home: is it possible and how does it work?
pageTitle: Underfloor Heating in an Existing Home: Is It Possible? | AZGS
description: Underfloor heating in an existing home is possible more often than you think. Complete guide on routing, overlay systems, and floor finish for your renovation in the Utrecht region.
intro: Underfloor heating is no longer reserved for new construction. More and more homeowners in existing homes are adding underfloor heating during renovations — for extra comfort, efficiency, and a clean look without radiators. What are the options, what should you keep in mind, and when is it a good investment?
